answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. Much like the slow erosion of a karst landscape, the cumulative cost of acquiring sufficient stake becomes an impassable horizon for attackers. By burning capital—akin to a dying ember—the protocol forces malicious actors to bear the economic weight of their subversion, rendering the creation of multiple counterfeit identities prohibitively expensive compared to the potential illicit yield.
